blurb: Guests stay in luxury rooms and suites with private balconies and views of the Santa Rosa Mountains or pool. The resort offers amenities including a heated outdoor pool, fitness center, tennis courts, and on-site dining. It serves as a base for exploring Anza-Borrego Desert State Park and enjoying activities like hiking, stargazing, and golf.
